item.description: All of the Thorpe Park latest updates in January 2025, including the potential removal of events, landscaping work and preparation for Slammer's removal.

item.description: All of the Thorpe Park latest updates in February 2025, including brand new information, landscaping work and Slammer's removal.

item.title: Thorpe Park Kicks Off 2025 With Unforgettable Thrills & Record-Breaking Adventures - Thorpe Guide
item.description: Thorpe Park Fright Nights is back and it’s bigger, faster and more fiendish than ever. Running on selected dates between 4th October - 3rd November 2024 from 10am-9pm, prepare yourself for the ultimate day and night of exhilarating thrills and teeth-chattering chills.

item.title: New Planet Doughnut & Harbor Desserts Food Units For 2025 - Thorpe Guide
item.description: Goodbye to Granny's Apple Fries & Doughnut Time... and hello to Planet Doughnut & Harbor Desserts, both new to the park for 2025!

item.title: Fright Nights Wins Best Theme Park Event At The ScareCON Awards 2025! - Thorpe Guide
item.description: The ScareCON Awards 2025 were hosted at the Heart of England Convention Centre on the 20th May. Thorpe Park were nominated for 4 awards this year & won best theme park event!

item.title: FRIGHT NIGHTS 2025 Lineup Revealed - Thorpe Guide
item.description: The full line up for FRIGHT NIGHTS 2024 has just been announced - this year sees the return of fan favourite attractions & a NEW for 2024 maze!

item.title: Thorpe Park Unleashes Fright Nights® 2025 - Bigger, Darker and Deadlier Than Ever Before - Thorpe Guide
item.description: Thorpe Park’s Fright Nights® returns for 2025 and promises to be bigger, darker and more terrifying than ever before.

item.title: Thorpe Park Latest Updates September 2025 - Thorpe Guide
item.description: September has been a busy month so far on the island! 🏝️ From preparation for this year's Fright Nights 👻, an early Fright Nights Freestyle teaser, to new merchandise and the return of beloved effects, we've got a lot of exciting updates to cover in this feature!

item.title: Thorpe Park Fright Nights 2025 Review: The Strongest Year Yet - Thorpe Guide
item.description: Thorpe Park Fright Nights 2025 sets a new benchmark for theme park Halloween events in the UK. With revamped mazes, all-new scare zones and jaw-dropping shows, this year’s event delivers more atmosphere, more creativity and more chaos than ever before.

item.title: Merlin Ride Access Pass Changes Spark Concern Over Fairness and Accessibility - Thorpe Guide
item.description: Merlin Ride Access Pass changes have caused backlash from guests, with concerns over hidden disabilities, eligibility & access at Merlin's parks.
